description: This file defines an enum 'GatewayConnectionIssue' representing different connection issues for a gateway, including methods to detect issues from status text and extract request IDs.

methods.name: detect(from:)
methods.description: Detects the type of gateway connection issue based on the provided status text.

methods.name: extractRequestId(from:)
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a status text, if present.
